intro.text: The nickname a mysterious stranger gives the spirit-corpse he rides across the mists of the Cognitive Realm around Scadrial.

items.text: Drifted on the mists of Scadrial's Cognitive Realm. The stranger who rode it was partly in the Physical Realm, and used it as a boat to keep from sinking through the mists, steering with an oar coated in a glowing substance. Bantering with Kelsier, he claimed Spanky's parents were still alive, though he may have been making it up.

appearance.text: A body in a white robe, floating face-down and motionless in the mists.

personality.text: A Cognitive Shadow that hardly reacts to anything around it, though it mumbles something back when spoken to, so it seems to keep a little awareness. Where it came from is unknown.
